environment.description: Kubernetes cluster running order-service in 'commerce' namespace. Istio sidecar injected but NO AuthorizationPolicy applied. The correlation-svc in 'platform-services' namespace is accessible from any namespace. External traffic reaches the order-service via Istio IngressGateway with no request validation. When a request arrives without X-Correlation-Id header or with an invalid one, ResolveContextAsync returns null, causing NullReferenceException on line accessing resolvedContext.TenantId. The default ASP.NET Core error handling exposes full stack traces in Development mode (ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Development).

config.ingress: istio-ingressgateway with VirtualService routing to order-service:80
